history.title: Battle of Agincourt
history.text: The Battle of Agincourt was a major English victory in the Hundred Years' War. It took place on 25 October 1415 (Saint Crispin's Day) near Azincourt, in northern France. Henry V of England led his troops against a much larger French army. The battle is celebrated as one of the greatest military victories of England. Casualties on the French side were enormous, including many noblemen. Today the village of Azincourt has a small museum about the battle.

non_history.title: Marigold
non_history.text: Marigold is a genus of herbaceous plants in the sunflower family. The genus includes about 50 species of annual and perennial plants. They are native to the Americas but cultivated worldwide for their bright orange and yellow flowers. Gardeners often plant them in flower beds. The petals are sometimes used as a food colouring.
